It was 11,160 B before the documentation was added. 0.9: the Doqs core stylesheet gained the playground styles (about 0.9 KB gzip). Official-site 1.0 readiness: the redesigned landing and the new /examples page add utility classes plus about 1 KB raw of site CSS (active-route indicator, hero glow, documentation preview window); measured 16,772 B before and 17,372 B after (+600 B gzip) on the same machine. Spec 0017 (theme switch and landing redesign): the CSS-driven theme switch, the view-transition rules and the landing’s hero, card, step and call-to-action styles plus their utility classes; measured 17,584 B before and 19,004 B after (+1,420 B gzip) on the same machine.

The landing, the documentation index and 41 documents: 0.10 adds two guides and the 20-page Content tooling API reference (21 + 22). 0.11 adds the guide Adopting Doqs in an existing library site (44 pages). The official-site 1.0 readiness work adds the /examples page (45 pages).

Analog bundles the frontmatter and a loader of every Markdown file of every version into the first-loaded JavaScript; Doqs cannot lazy-load that through a supported Analog API. Measured 20 -> 200 generated documents (+ half as many archived): 52 B gzip per document; 20 -> 1000: 46 B. A jump means Doqs added per-document work to the browser bundle.
